description: Single YAM: one YAM on the left base; a parked MakerMods Metal on the right base is a static obstacle (never commanded), with its model, base placement and 70 mm wrist/gripper envelope from the YAM + Metal profile.
source: Derived from the yam and yam_metal profiles: the left arm, top/left cameras and static obstacles from yam; the right arm, its attachment envelope and the table plane from yam_metal; the Metal Home from its hardware settings; a nominal parked pose.

parked.gripper_note: Geometry only: the Metal model encloses its complete finger stroke in its 70 mm wrist/gripper envelope, so the jaw value changes no clearance.
parked.source: Nominal: the Metal parked at its Home.

top.note: optical frame (+z forward, +y down) in the table frame; NOMINAL guess (1.04 m over the felt, looking straight down, arms at the image bottom) until the overhead check calibrates the camera; fovy_deg is a nominal vertical field of view for the 640x480 stream

table.source: Bases directly on the tabletop without risers; the Metal replaces the right base at the same mounting position. The 70 mm attachment is under the wrist/gripper, not under the base.

camera_pole.note: overhead camera pole (about 60 cm, at the bases' midpoint, toward the back); nominal

camera_head.note: the RealSense on top of the pole, with margin

attachments.note: Wrist and gripper bounds expanded by 70 mm in all directions; includes the entire jaw stroke.
